title: The Artificial flower on the table
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：artificial　|　正文 334 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 artificial 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the keeper wrote of ① an artificial flower on the table in the register, and everybody in the zoo said at once that it was ② more artificial than the one named there the year before. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the keeper, who never explained anything, had done it year after year and gone home; it was the artificial ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the most artificial flower on the table anybody in the zoo had ever seen, or so the register for March 1962 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too artificial to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the child who had come to help; the artificial ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an artificial smile, and said that no child in his right mind would call it ⑥ as artificial as the smile they had once had in the old zoo. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was artificial or not, and he said so.

By 1975 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was ⑦ something artificial, and nothing besides. The child from the next zoo called the whole plan ⑧ quite artificial; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the register kept the names of the artificial ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1978, for the whole place, she wrote of another artificial flower on the table in the same register, and the work, which took two seasons, seemed  more artificial than anybody had expected.  The most artificial smile in the whole zoo, she said in 1980, was the one she could never quite name; the artificial ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 人造（前置定语 an artificial flower on the table：1968 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的那件人造的花）
B. adj. 人造／虚假（比较级 more artificial than：文中两处，一处比桌上的花，一处比预想）
C. adj. 人造／虚假（最高级 the most artificial：文中两处，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 人造（表语 too artificial to do：母亲觉得它太人造，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 虚假（前置定语 an artificial smile：叔叔把整件事称作一桩虚假的笑容）
F. adj. 虚假（同级比较 as artificial as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩笑容相比）
G. adj. 虚假（后置定语 something artificial：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 虚假（受程度副词修饰 quite artificial：那位孩子的评价）

items.q: an artificial flower on the table
the most artificial flower on the table anybody

answers.why: artificial 意为“人造”，1968 年饲养员在饲养台账里记下的是“一件人造的花”，此处作前置定语 an artificial flower on the table。
artificial 意为“人造”，此处用比较级 more artificial than，拿它跟前一年记下的那一个相比。
artificial 意为“人造”，饲养台账上 三月 那行字说它是兽舍里最人造的一件，故用最高级 the most artificial flower on the table。
artificial 意为“人造”，母亲认为这件东西“太人造了，谁也用不上”，too artificial to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
artificial 意为“虚假”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩虚假的笑容”，此处作前置定语 an artificial smile。
artificial 意为“虚假”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩笑容一样虚假”，同级比较用 as artificial as。
artificial 意为“虚假”，饲养台账上那半行字要的是“虚假的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something artificial。
artificial 意为“虚假”，邻兽舍来的那位孩子认为这套计划“相当虚假”，quite 修饰原级 artificial。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1968 年，饲养员在饲养台账里记下了一件人造的花。（an artificial flower on the table）
人人都说它比前一年记下的那一个更人造。（more artificial than …）
母亲觉得它太人造，谁也用不上。（too artificial to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩虚假的笑容。（an artificial smile）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩笑容一样虚假。（as artificial as …）
到了 1975 年，饲养台账上只剩半行字：要的是一件虚假的东西。（something artificial）
answers: In 1968 the keeper wrote of an artificial flower on the table in the register.
Everybody said it was more artificial than the one named there the year before.
My mother thought it too artificial to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an artificial smile.
He said nobody would call it as artificial as the smile they had once had.
By 1975 the register asked for nothing but something artificial.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: In 1968 the keeper wrote of an artificial flower on the table in the register, and nobody forgot it.
It was the most artificial flower on the table in the zoo, or so the register says.
My mother thought it too artificial to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an artificial smile, and nobody argued with him.
